name: Differentiable Blending Point Renderer
definition: A differentiable point-based rasterizer that uses blending to render points, enabling automatic optimization of point opacities to identify and remove outliers without manual topological operations.
summary: The Differentiable Blending Point Renderer is a point-based rasterizer that uses front-to-back alpha blending with sigmoid opacity parameterization to enable direct gradient-based optimization of geometry and appearance.
